title: Medications and diagnoses cleared within a year

tellings.quote: I was released from every single psychological diagnosises.

plain: A man named Jordan Jose, who says a secret UFO program took him as a child, says that around 2010 in Springville, New York, he came off his medications and was cleared of all his psychological diagnoses within about a year. He tells Michels this himself, saying "I was released from every single" diagnosis, which he offers as a sign that what happened to him was real and not illness.
